tasks.subject: Deepen a code-action module (rielj.lsp.action)
tasks.description:
Create lua/rielj/lsp/action.lua owning the LSP code-action wire format: apply({bufnr, kind, filter, sync}). Handles diagnostic conversion (vim.lsp.diagnostic.from), codeAction/resolve, command vs edit dispatch, offset encoding. Rewrite callers: lua/rielj/tsgo-tools.lua apply_code_action, lua/rielj/lsp/handlers.lua tailwind fns, ftdetect/go.lua organizeImports.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Deepening code-action module

tasks.description:

tasks.subject: One home per plugin: merge after/plugin into lazy specs
tasks.description:
Fold each after/plugin/X.lua into matching lua/custom/plugins/X.lua spec config/opts/keys. 11 duplicated names: completion, statusline, treesitter, nvimtree, bufferline, markdown, snippets, spectre, terminal, comment, dashboard.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Merging plugin configs into specs

tasks.subject: Keymaps behind one seam (rielj.keymap)
tasks.description:
Give lua/rielj/keymap.lua a real implementation: map/bufmap with collision detection and descriptions. Route plugin/keymappings.lua, handlers.lsp_keymaps, tsgo-tools.on_attach through it. Fix dead maps: duplicate <leader>gb, <leader>ll TroubleToggle, gl vim.lsp.diagnostic.show_line_diagnostics. Replace command strings with Lua callbacks.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Consolidating keymaps
